candidates.change_summary: Replace the ownership check to allow anyone to call sendTo (remove require(msg.sender == owner)).
Change the zero-address check to allow sending to the zero address (remove require(receiver != address(0))).
Change the positive-amount check to allow zero amounts (remove require(amount > 0)).
Invert the owner check to REQUIRE the caller is NOT the owner, preventing owner from calling sendTo while allowing others.
Insert a check that caps the maximum transferable amount to 1 ether, preventing larger transfers.
